text: 8月7日，中国稀土发布2026年半年度报告，实现营业收入16.47亿元，同比下降12.19%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润2.37亿元，同比增长46.53%。报告期内，稀土行业供需格局持续调整优化，受稀土产业政策、下游市场需求提振等多重有利因素影响，市场行情整体上行，镨钕产品价格较去年同期涨幅明显。（新京报）
text_en: On August 7, China Rare Earth released its 2026 semi-annual report, posting operating revenue of 1.647 billion yuan, down 12.19% year-on-year; net profit attributable to shareholders of listed companies was 237 million yuan, up 46.53% year-on-year. During the reporting period, supply-demand dynamics in the rare earth industry continued to adjust and optimize. Driven by multiple favorable factors such as rare earth industry policies and downstream market demand, the overall market trended upward, with praseodymium-neodymium product prices rising markedly versus the same period last year. (Beijing News)
